$comment: openspec/changes/publish-from-stackiq. Seeds the Applicatielandschap catalogue over stackiq's application-level schemas, named by slug. Without stackiq the slugs stay unresolved and the catalogue publishes nothing; CatalogScopePendingListener completes the scope when stackiq's register appears later. It ships unpublished; SettingsService::backfillCatalogScopes() publishes it the first time its scope resolves completely (PUBLISH_WHEN_RESOLVED). Which stackiq objects and fields an anonymous visitor sees is decided by stackiq's own read rules (object level and property level), never by this catalogue.
